correctness.rationale: From exact survival S and tail integration, C prime has sign c-Delta R. Both rates R strictly decrease from q mu to zero, so caps are unique; explicit formulas follow. For F(x)=exp(x)-(1+x/k)^(k+1)-x/(k alpha), F(0)=0, F prime and double-prime are negative initially and F triple-prime is strictly positive for every k>0, forcing exactly one strictly positive zero. This zero yields exactly one reversal of optimizers because the homogeneous cap is strictly increasing in M. 1274 checked diagnostics and reproducible benchmark values support but are not the continuum proof. q=1 and non-Gamma laws are excluded.

value.rationale: Stopping on first detection makes executed survey costs endogenous. Persistent within-site Gamma frailty produces competing early hazard loss and long-tail survival; the exact result determines, for any nontrivial occupancy and shape, which direction mean-rate planning biases the optimal search cap and when that direction switches exactly once. This complete natural classification is more informative than examples, mere reproducibility or the known fact that heterogeneous detectability matters; a field-specific calibration is outside scope.
